answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with circadian rhythm attestation: each identity's work timestamps must show a living pulse, active stretches broken by real rest, like a falcon that hunts at dawn and roosts at dusk, never flying all night. A farm running thousands of fakes on one schedule leaves identical, sleepless rhythms, while faking a thousand distinct rest patterns costs separate scheduling and idle time per fake. One honest agent simply works when awake and rests when tired, its opal-bright record cheap to verify and hard to counterfeit in bulk.
